about_the_game:
Pick any button on your keyboard or controller to make your bottle jump through obstacle-filled levels. Just don't use too much power, or your bottle will CRACK!

Key Features

  • Party or Solo: Play in a group or test your skills solo for speedruns.

  • Local Multiplayer: Play with unlimited friends on the same device! Each player only needs one button, so anyone can join in. Set up quick and chaotic local matches.

  • Online Multiplayer: Join public or private rooms with up to 12 players and compete worldwide. Enjoy proximity-based voice chat for extra chaos.

  • Varied Game Modes:

    • Traditional mode: Move together while avoiding obstacles.

    • Leader mode: The camera follows the player in front, and those who fall too far behind are destroyed.

    • Race Mode (Online Mode): Race against others with the camera following your bottle.

    • Custom options: Disable checkpoints, timers, or player collisions for unique challenge.

  • Customization: Unlock cosmetics for bottle trails and explosions, collect different bottle models by achieving in-game milestones, and earn emotes for the emote wheel.

  • In-Game Currency: Earn bottle caps by playing online to purchase cosmetics, emotes, and more.

Experience the chaos, compete with friends, and see if you don't make your BOTTLE CRACKS!
